items.quote: Calculate the correlation coefficient between ApplicantIncome and LoanAmount.
items.description: 計算 ApplicantIncome 與 LoanAmount 的 Pearson 相關係數，四捨五入到小數點後兩位，與 answer.txt 中 @correlation_coefficient 的值比對。

items.quote: @correlation_coefficient[corr_coeff] where "corr_coeff" is a number between -1 and 1, rounded to two decimal places
items.description: answer.txt 必須包含 @correlation_coefficient[value] 項目，值為介於 -1 與 1 之間的數字，四捨五入到兩位小數。

items.quote: Ignore the rows with missing values for either of the two columns.
items.description: 計算相關係數時須排除 ApplicantIncome 或 LoanAmount 任一欄為缺失值的列；pearson2 重算口徑即以兩欄皆有效的列計算，與 answer.txt 的值比對。

items.quote: Put each answer item on its own line, in the form `@name[value]`, using exactly the names given under "Answer format" in the task.
items.description: answer.txt 中答案項須以 @name[value] 格式逐行撰寫，且名稱須與 Answer format 指定的 correlation_coefficient 完全一致。

items.quote: The data file is input. Do not change it.
items.description: 資料檔僅為輸入，不得修改；重算以原始資料檔為準，可間接偵測資料檔是否被變更。
